_comment: Merge these into your Laravel project's composer.json, then copy openapi-policy.php and scripts/ into the project root (or a package). Point `spec` and `out` in openapi-policy.php at your paths, set invokerPackage to your namespace, and run `composer generate-api`. Wire it into CI by running `composer generate-api` before your build/test step so nothing ever runs against a stale or unverified contract. The generator needs Java on PATH (or set OPENAPI_GENERATOR_CMD to 'npx @openapitools/openapi-generator-cli').
